title: MemoryGrantsGrantRequest
description: Issue a grant. Non-amplification: every issued dimension must be a subset of the granter effective coverage, otherwise NOT_AUTHORIZED (§6.5). Grant: admin with coverage subsuming the issued grant. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2). Expressed as closed variants because draft-07 conditionals (if/then/else) are not derivable by the codegen toolchain; the variant shapes encode the §6.5 rule exactly: shared_access is meaningful only with context_ids and MUST be omitted when context_ids is omitted.

principal_id.description: Target grantee — a selector, never requester identity (§6.4).
principal_id.title: PrincipalId

capabilities.description: Open capability vocabulary. Core (documented, not enforced): capture, review, records_read, records_write, recall, profile_write, reflect, promote, transfer, admin. Non-amplification: must be a subset of the granter effective coverage (§6.5).

context_ids.description: Placement-context restriction: only the listed contexts, plus shared visibility iff shared_access is true.

shared_access.description: Optional; default false. Only meaningful with context_ids (§6.5).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1–128 characters (§6.1); unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
